name: McHenry Lakehouse

seo.title: McHenry Lakehouse · Private-lake cabin with heated pool near Chicago
seo.description: A 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath lake cabin in McHenry, Illinois with a heated outdoor pool, hot tub, private lake access, dock and canoe. Sleeps 12, dog-friendly, about an hour from Chicago.

hero.title: Your own private lake,
hero.lede: A four-bedroom cabin with a heated pool, hot tub, dock and canoe, made for big families, reunions and long summer weekends.
hero.alt: Heated outdoor pool behind the lake cabin

intro.title: Room to spread out, water on every side
body: Tucked into a quiet corner of McHenry, this lakefront cabin gives a big group space to be together and space to get away. The heated pool and hot tub are the heart of summer here. Just past the pool, a path leads down to a dock on a small private lake where you can fish from the pier or paddle out in the canoe.

Inside: warm cabin decor with a playful bear theme, a full kitchen plus a retro kitchenette, a separate dining room, an office for anyone who has to log in, and a downstairs bar for evenings in. Every bedroom has easy access to a bathroom, so mornings with twelve people stay calm.
Pistakee Lake and the Chain O'Lakes are a three-minute walk away for boating, and the shops, beaches and restaurants of McHenry and Fox Lake are a short drive.

area.intro: McHenry sits on the Fox River at the edge of the Chain O'Lakes, one of the busiest boating areas in the Midwest. Summer means pontoon days, sandbars and fireworks over the water. In the off-season it's nature trails, small-town diners and the antique shops along the river.

places.name: Pistakee Lake
places.text: Part of the Chain O'Lakes. Rent a boat or jet ski nearby and explore 15 connected lakes.

places.name: Volo Bog State Natural Area
places.text: A rare quaking bog with a floating boardwalk trail. Great for an easy family walk.

places.name: Volo Museum
places.text: Hundreds of classic and movie cars, plus antique malls. A good rainy-day pick.

places.name: Petersen Park Beach
places.text: McHenry's city beach and park on McCullom Lake, with a swimming beach and playgrounds.

places.name: Riverside Chocolate Factory
places.text: Sweet shop on the river in downtown McHenry, close to restaurants and bars.

places.name: Gurnee Mills

rules: Up to 12. Please keep the group to the number on your booking.

safety: Children must be supervised by an adult at the pool, hot tub, dock and lake at all times. There is no lifeguard.
The pool is heated for the summer season. Ask us about exact opening and closing dates for your trip.
Canoe use is at your own risk. Please wear life jackets on the water.
Boats for Pistakee Lake and the Chain O'Lakes can be rented from local marinas nearby.
On-site parking is included. Please don't block neighbors' driveways.
The exact address, door code and Wi-Fi details are shared before arrival.
faq: Is the pool heated, and when is it open?
Yes, the outdoor pool is heated. It's a seasonal outdoor pool, generally open late spring through early fall depending on weather. Send us your dates and we'll confirm.
Yes. Up to two dogs are welcome, each 50 lb or less. Please mention them in your request.
Is the house on the water?
The property has its own access and dock on a small private lake just past the pool, with a canoe and fishing from the pier. The larger Pistakee Lake and the Chain O'Lakes are about a 3-minute walk.
Can we bring or rent a boat?
Several marinas around Pistakee Lake rent pontoons and other boats by the day. Guests regularly rent one for a day on the Chain.
Is it good for families and groups?
That's who it's built for. Four bedrooms, a futon, four and a half baths, two kitchens and a big backyard give a group of up to 12 room to spread out.
Book instantly on VRBO, or send a request on this site and we'll reply with a quote and any questions.
Yes, there's a dedicated office space in the house.
